title: Give every embedded acceptance an acc: identity

facts.note: Any WMBT file that embeds acceptances, whether or not it changed in the current diff. A file-kind observer that classifies a file as a WMBT for activation is not established by the supplied files; one is needed.
Vendored and generated trees are never scanned (authored exception).

values: embedded acceptance is not an object whose identity.urn starts with acc:
facts.note: Needs an observer that parses each scanned WMBT, enumerates its embedded acceptances (new, edited and untouched), and emits a finding per acceptance that is a scalar, lacks identity.urn, or has an identity.urn not starting with acc:. The source names the validator planner_plan_integrity as the implementation, but no existing activation observer or emitted finding contract is established by the supplied files.

fires: A WMBT embeds an acceptance as a bare string instead of an object.
A WMBT embeds an acceptance object with no identity.urn.
An embedded acceptance has an identity.urn that does not start with acc: (e.g. a different URN scheme).
An existing, untouched acceptance in a scanned WMBT lacks an acc: identity.urn — it is still in scope.
doesNotFire: A WMBT file inside node_modules, dist, build or _generated.
Every acceptance embedded in the WMBT is an object whose identity.urn starts with acc:.
A WMBT that embeds no acceptances.

given: A WMBT outside vendored/generated trees embeds one or more acceptances — new, edited, or untouched.
when: An embedded acceptance is encountered in a scanned WMBT.
then: Every embedded acceptance is an object whose `identity.urn` starts with `acc:`.
prefer: Give the acceptance `identity: { urn: acc:<wagon>:<id> }`, using the owning wagon and a stable acceptance id.
avoid: Embedding an acceptance as a bare string or an object without `identity.urn`.
An `identity.urn` that uses any prefix other than `acc:`.
Leaving pre-existing embedded acceptances without an `acc:` identity because you did not edit them.
unless: The file is in a vendored or generated tree (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) — these are never scanned.
why: Tests bind acceptances by their acc: identity; an acceptance without it can never be proven.
evidence: The planner_plan_integrity validator reports no embedded acceptance lacking an `identity.urn` starting with `acc:`.
Every acceptance embedded in each scanned WMBT is an object whose `identity.urn` starts with `acc:` (e.g. `acc:<wagon>:<id>`).
verifier_detail: Check: each acceptance embedded in a WMBT must be an object (not a scalar) with `identity.urn` whose value starts with `acc:`; otherwise emit a finding. Applies to all embedded acceptances in scanned WMBTs, not only changed ones.
